14:07.race_name: Sporting Times Restricted Maiden Stakes (For horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Struggled in two bumpers this winter and can only be watched on Flat debut
runners.name: Cribbins
runners.spotlight: Down the field in a Hereford bumper on debut in December and was beaten miles when last of nine at Catterick (1m7f, soft) the following month; still early days but he has a lot to prove now switched to the Flat.

runners.comment: Poor hurdles form and he struggled at massive prices in two Flat runs (1m) last month.
runners.name: Callero
runners.spotlight: Poor hurdles form and he struggled at massive prices in two Flat runs (1m) last month.

runners.comment: Promising fourth here (1m3f) in January and he's open to more progress back up in trip
runners.name: John Galt
runners.spotlight: Never-dangerous fourth in two runs this winter but he caught the eye with his late headway here (1m3f) in January and that was behind a useful rival; looks open to more progress on this step back up in trip and he's respected for in-form yard.

runners.comment: Ran green when well held here (1m) in December; gelded since and now steps up to 1m4f
runners.name: Cranachan
runners.spotlight: Son of Cracksman out of a sister to a 1m4f Grade 1 winner; didn't live up to market expectations on debut here (1m) in December and he refused to enter the stalls at Lingfield later that month; has been gelded since but he now takes a big step up in trip and it wouldn't be a surprise if he left his initial form well behind.

runners.comment: RPRs in the 50s in two runs here late last year; needs a transformation after a break
runners.name: Mythical Valentine
runners.spotlight: Has useful pedigree but he recorded RPRs in the 50s when well held in two runs here (1m/1m3f) late last year; still early days but he needs a transformation after a break.

runners.comment: Clear promise in two runs this winter and he's a big player on this step up to 1m4f
runners.name: Charles Darnay
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to three winners including Land Of Oz (1m6f-2m including AW; RPR 99); showed clear promise in his two runs this year, most recently when third of 12 at Southwell (1m) last month; has leading claims on that form and he's open to progress on this big step up in trip.

runners.comment: Always in rear and was long way behind Charles Darnay on Southwell debut (1m) last month
runners.name: Havanas Tune
runners.spotlight: Always in rear and he finished a long way behind Charles Darnay on Southwell debut (1m) last month; tongue-tie is now added and he steps up to 1m4f.

runners.comment: Yard 3-59 in maidens in recent years and he could be one for later on
runners.name: NIon
runners.spotlight: 4,500euros yearling, 13,000euros 2yo; closely related to French 1m winner San Fabrizio (RPR 101), half-brother to four winners including Dancing In Paris (1m-1m6f including AW; 100) and Beechwood Jude (1m3f-2m; 85); dam placed 10.5f/1m4f, out of 1m7f Group 2 winner; yard 3-59 in maidens in recent years and he could be one for later on.

runners.comment: Struggled at big prices in two runs (1m3f) this year and he can only be watched
runners.name: Glamerous
runners.spotlight: Always behind on debut here (1m3f) in January and was tailed off over the same trip at Southwell (200-1) last month.

14:37.race_name: Visit Sri Lanka Handicap (London Sprint Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Needs improvement to defy top weight and may be more interesting when back on turf
runners.name: Euphonia
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden who has failed to back up debut effort (sole turf attempt); needs improvement to defy top weight and may be more interesting when back on grass.

runners.comment: Ran with some promise at Kempton last time; open to improvement on handicap debut
runners.name: Hurricane Ann
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced filly who ran with some promise at Kempton (7f) most recently and shapes as if this drop in trip is worth exploring on handicap debut; open to improvement.

runners.comment: Sole attempt at Kempton resulted in her only success (off 3lb lower); could go well
runners.name: Houdini Miss
runners.spotlight: Somewhat exposed but her sole attempt at Kempton resulted in her only success (over 7f off 3lb lower); placed in both attempts in 6f handicaps; could go well.

runners.comment: Ran well at Lingfield last week when bidding for a double; open to further progress
runners.name: Life After Love
runners.spotlight: Ran well, despite a tardy start, at Lingfield last week when bidding for a 5f double; gives the impression she'll be as effective back over 6f; open to further progress and warrants respect.

runners.comment: Penultimate effort puts him in the picture; latest race didn't pan out favourably
runners.name: Faithful Dream
runners.spotlight: Solid effort at Wolverhampton (6f) on penultimate start, suggesting there's an ordinary handicap in him; the race didn't pan out favourably at Newcastle five days later; remains of interest.

runners.comment: Far from convincing on form
runners.name: Amakhala
runners.spotlight: Far from convincing, having finished last in three of his four starts, latest at Kempton (7f) on handicap/seasonal debut; best watched unless the market speaks positively.

runners.comment: Last two attempts on Polytrack represent his best handicap form
runners.name: Saeculamation
runners.spotlight: Last two attempts on Polytrack represent his best handicap form, namely close second at Lingfield (5f) and account-opening win at Chelmsford (6f); return to this surface looks a plus.

runners.comment: Maiden who is proving consistent, close third at Lingfield most recently
runners.name: Real Gold
runners.spotlight: Still a maiden but is proving consistent, close third at Lingfield (6f) most recently; first win is not out of the question, with Billy Loughnane on board; usually apprentice ridden.

runners.comment: Went down by only a neck at Wolverhampton on Friday; inconsistent otherwise
runners.name: Magnificent Mel
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden who went down by only a neck at Wolverhampton (6f) on Friday; may remain competitive, provided that form is backed up (has proved inconsistent).

15:07.race_name: Sporting Times/Sri Lanka Awaits You Handicap (London Sprint Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Unexposed colt but he has something to prove dropped to 6f for new yard; tongue-tie off
runners.name: Dragon God
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise in his qualifying runs but he returned after wind surgery with heavy defeat on handicap debut at Wolverhampton (7f, Tapeta; 18-1) in December; left Charlie Hills since then and has something to prove now switched to sprinting for new yard; tongue-tie removed.

runners.comment: Eight-time AW winner who ran well when third at Wolverhampton last Monday; respected
runners.name: Twilight Madness
runners.owner: P R Hedger & P C F Racing Ltd
runners.spotlight: Eight-time AW winner including two over C&D; his last success was off only 1lb lower at Wolverhampton in December and he ran well to finish third there (6f) last Monday; cheekpieces now return and he's respected from good draw.

runners.comment: Nine-race maiden who has been out of sorts in last three runs and others are preferred
runners.name: Rory Rocket
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on his second at Goodwood (6f, good) last August but he's lost his way in last three runs and was beaten 13l on his C&D reappearance last month; record is now 0-9 and others are preferred.

runners.comment: Got back on track with a win over C&D in January and he's only 2lb higher here; respected
runners.name: Big Bard
runners.spotlight: Nine-time winner who got back on track with a narrow success over C&D (17-2) in January; drawn out wide this time but he's only 2lb higher than for that last run and could be a major force again.

runners.comment: Nine of his ten wins have been over 5f and he's been out of sorts this winter; passed over
runners.name: Bang On The Bell
runners.spotlight: Nine of his ten wins have been over 5f and he's been well held in his four runs this winter; mark continues to fall but he has plenty to prove on this step back up in trip; visor worn last time is removed.

runners.comment: Won over C&D last September but he's struggled in three subsequent runs
runners.name: Early Release
runners.spotlight: Made all for a clearcut win over C&D last September but he's been a long way below that form in three subsequent runs; had a tough draw at Wolverhampton last month but he needs a major revival back on Polytrack.

runners.comment: Four-time turf winner who is still unexposed on AW; market informative on stable debut
runners.name: Sub Thirteen
runners.spotlight: Four-time turf winner who is unexposed on AW and was respectable fourth at Southwell (6f) in his final run for Tony Carroll; continues to edge down the weights and has possibilities if he can find something extra for new yard.

runners.comment: Hard to predict but he ran well on Newcastle reappearance last month; possibilities
runners.name: Andalprofit
runners.spotlight: Has a patchy record but he won at Redcar (6f, good) in November and was a close fourth on his reappearance at Newcastle (Tapeta) last month; has wide draw back on Polytrack but he's tactically versatile and could be in the thick of things again.

runners.comment: Losing run is mounting up and he was disappointing when favourite on recent stable debut
runners.name: Beelzebub
runners.spotlight: Has three wins on AW but losing run is mounting up and he was laboured when favourite on recent on stable debut at Chelmsford (6f, AW; 11-4); tongue-tie now returns and he needs to get back on track.

runners.comment: 0-12 but she's well treated on best form and needs a close look after a short break
runners.name: Rye
runners.spotlight: 0-12 but runner-up twice in a row at Wolverhampton in the autumn and she had an excuse against a pace bias there in December; remains feasibly treated on her best form and she's not ruled out after a break.

runners.comment: Unexposed 4yo but he needs a transformation for new yard; now gelded and hood is added
runners.name: Charging Bull
runners.spotlight: Promise on his 2yo debut but he struggled in three subsequent runs for Andrew Balding, including a Southwell handicap (6f) in January; has been gelded and hood is now added but he needs a transformation for new yard (changed hands for 3,500gns).

runners.comment: Triple 7f winner but he has an uninspiring record over sprint trips; mixed messages
runners.name: Drafted
runners.spotlight: All of his three wins have been over 7f and latest was at Dundalk (AW) in October; made a solid start for this yard when third at Chelmsford (7f) last month but this is a different test and he has an uninspiring record (4657008) over sprint trips; mixed messages.

runners.breeder: Airlie Stud & Mrs S M Rogers
runners.comment: Landed the odds at Southwell and she's open to more progress on handicap debut; respected
runners.name: Lady Dora Mae
runners.spotlight: Some promise at the Curragh (1m) in sole Irish start; short-priced favourite in both runs for current yard and she had a near miss at Lingfield (7f) before winning at Southwell (1m) in January; has more to do now switched to a handicap but it's still early days for this well-bred filly and she could have a lot more to offer.

runners.comment: Unexposed colt who made all when winning a 7f maiden at Chelmsford last time; key player
runners.name: Stay Salty
runners.spotlight: 100,000gns yearling; promising fourth behind a smart prospect here (1m) on debut in January and he built on that when making all to beat an odds-on rival at Chelmsford (7f); looks on fair mark now switched to a handicap and he has plenty of scope for further progress; big player.

runners.comment: Placed on stable debut at Wolverhampton (6f) but he needs to build on that; tongue-tie on
runners.name: Yachtsman
runners.spotlight: Has good pedigree but he didn't progress in four runs for the Gosdens last summer; returned after a gelding operation with solid third on stable debut at Wolverhampton (6f) in January but he needs to build on that back up in trip; tongue-tie added.

runners.comment: Handicap newcomer who was eyecatching third at Wolverhampton (7f) last time; in the mix
runners.name: Dance Fantasy
runners.spotlight: No impact at 10-1 or bigger in three qualifying runs this winter but she had some traffic issues when an eyecatching third at Wolverhampton (7f) last time; looks interesting now switched to a handicap and she needs watching in market.

runners.comment: 0-4 but he wasn't beaten far here last time and is a possible improver at this new trip
runners.name: Saxon Prince
runners.spotlight: Four-race maiden but he started his handicap career with a rallying fifth here (6f) in January and was beaten less than 2l in that race; looks a possible improver now upped to 7f and he's not ruled out for in-form yard.

runners.comment: Four-time C&D winner but he needs a major revival back up in trip after a break
runners.name: Zero Carbon
runners.spotlight: His last four wins have been over C&D but latest was in August 2024; well handicapped on old form but he's been out of sorts in three runs for his current yard and was beaten 12l here (6f) in December; returns after a break and needs a major revival back up in trip; cheekpieces reapplied.

runners.comment: His last win was 19 months ago and he's struggled in four runs for current yard
runners.name: Media Shooter
runners.spotlight: Triple AW winner but his last success was 19 months ago and he's struggled in four runs for current yard; mark is tumbling but he needs a big turnaround back up in trip; cheekpieces return.

runners.comment: Unexposed on AW but was well held here (6f) last time and he's untried at this trip
runners.name: Mission Command
runners.spotlight: Dual turf winner who is unexposed on AW and was close third in a Class 4 handicap here (6f) in January; looks interesting on that form but he's not kicked on from that in two subsequent runs and he's untried at this trip; cheekpieces removed.

runners.comment: Seven-time AW winner who was a fair fourth at Chelmsford (7f) last time; in the mix
runners.name: How Impressive
runners.spotlight: Seven of his eight wins have come on AW, including two over C&D; only 1lb higher than for his last success in October and he ran for a long way when fourth at Chelmsford 18 days ago; has good draw back at this track and it wouldn't be a surprise if he made a bold bid.

runners.comment: Creditable third at Lingfield last time and has claims if he can back that up
runners.name: Iconic Times
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner who scored off 1lb higher here (6f) last summer; been up and down since then but he bounced back with a keeping-on third at Lingfield (7f) last month; has claims if he can back that up and he's in the mix with cheekpieces added.

runners.comment: Record of 7-18 on AW and he needs a close look on his return after five months off
runners.name: Bold Suitor
runners.spotlight: Record of 7-18 on AW and was in good form in the autumn, including a near miss at Chelmsford (7f); returns after five months off but he still looks feasibly treated and he went close on his reappearance last spring; interesting contender.

runners.comment: Losing run is up to 15 but he could be dangerous if he gets a good pace and some luck
runners.name: Tadreeb
runners.spotlight: Well held after a slow start here (1m) 12 days ago but that was after two solid placed efforts at Lingfield (7f/1m); losing run is now up to 15 but he's on a dangerous mark and could get involved if he gets a good pace and some luck; cheekpieces removed.

16:37.race_name: Sri Lanka Wonder Of Asia Handicap (GBBplus Race)

runners.comment: Better known as a stayer on the Flat these days and has some work to do back at this trip
runners.name: Charging Thunder
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose performer who is 3-9 on AW and his last win was off 3lb lower at Wolverhampton (1m6f) last July; returned to the Flat with an encouraging effort at Southwell (2m) in December but was never dangerous in that race and his last win over this trip was in 2022; has some work to do.

runners.comment: Went close in Class 2 at Southwell (1m4f) in final run last year; key player on his return
runners.name: Dramatic Star
runners.spotlight: Won twice in 2024, including over 1m4f on Tapeta; had only five runs last year but he went close on two occasions, including in a Class 2 at Southwell (1m4f) in November; 2lb higher on his return but he hit a personal best last time and he's a key player on this drop back in grade.

runners.comment: Back from long absence with two good runs including a win at Wolverhampton; in the mix
runners.name: Nolton Cross
runners.spotlight: Returned after almost two years off with a game win over 1m4f at Wolverhampton (12-1) last month; held in fourth in his follow-up bid at Lingfield but he wasn't beaten far and that another good effort in a valuable handicap; has raced prominently in his last two runs and he should go well again on this drop back in grade.

runners.comment: In good form at shorter trips before he struggled in the snow at St Moritz last time
runners.name: Parlando
runners.spotlight: Won at Chelmsford (1m2f) and Wolverhampton (9.4f) in December and was good second in his hat-trick bid at Newcastle; may still have some room to manoeuvre off this mark but he struggled in the snow at St Moritz last time and he still has stamina to prove at this trip.

runners.comment: Made it 6-11 at Kempton when scoring over 1m3f in January; respected up 2lb
runners.name: Whitcombe Rockstar
runners.spotlight: Most of his wins have been at 1m but he made it 6-11 at Kempton when swooping late for a last-gasp win over 1m3f in January; up 2lb but he remains well handicapped on his best form and is strongly respected back up in trip.

runners.comment: 4yo who is 2-3 and he's open to progress on this handicap debut; interesting contender
runners.name: Spanish Voice
runners.spotlight: 210,000gns yearling; very lightly raced 4yo who made it 2-3 when winning a Lingfield novice (1m2f) on his reappearance last month; that was a golden opportunity but he looks on fair mark now switched to a handicap and is open to more progress at this new trip; interesting contender.

runners.comment: Just 1-10 on AW and was well held in a Class 4 at Lingfield last time; opposable
runners.name: Great Bedwyn
runners.spotlight: Triple turf winner but he's 1-10 on AW and was well held in a Class 4 at Lingfield (1m4f) in December; had a wide trip in that race but this looks tough back up in grade and he's best watched back from a break.

runners.breeder: D & S L Tanker Transport Ltd
runners.comment: Tailed off in final run last summer and has plenty to prove back at this trip on return
runners.name: Legendary Day
runners.spotlight: Has won seven times on the Flat but last success was over 2m at Lingfield 13 months ago; on same mark here but he was tailed off in final run last summer and has plenty to prove back at this trip on his return.

runners.comment: Losing run is up to 21 but he's been placed in last three runs; each-way claims again
runners.name: Son Of Man
runners.spotlight: 21 defeats have followed a successful racecourse debut but he's been placed in his last three runs including a close third here (1m3f) 12 days ago; should go well again and he's in the mix back up in trip.

17:10.race_name: Sporting Times Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div I)

runners.comment: Won at Southwell in January and he looks worth another try at this trip; not ruled out
runners.name: Moyowasi
runners.spotlight: Made the breakthrough at Southwell (7f, Tapeta) in January, with a career best; hasn't posed a serious threat in two subsequent runs but he wasn't beaten far at Southwell last time and he looks worth another try at this trip; shortlisted.

runners.comment: Went close at Chelmsford in January and things didn't go her way last time; dangerous
runners.name: Brinton
runners.spotlight: Generally reliable mare who went close at Chelmsford (1m, Polytrack) last month and things didn't go her way when down the field over C&D last time; should get a better tow into this race and has claims if she gets some luck.

runners.comment: Only 1-22 and looks to have gone off the boil in her last three starts; tongue-tie removed
runners.name: Prefer The Sister
runners.spotlight: Only 1-23 and looks to have gone off the boil in her last three starts; dropped to career-low mark but needs to raise her game back up in trip; tongue-tie removed.

runners.comment: Seven-time turf winner but he's 0-13 on AW and others are more persuasive
runners.name: Revich
runners.spotlight: Seven-time turf winner but he's 0-13 on AW; reached the frame a couple of times over C&D in the autumn but this veteran has not really fired in his last two runs and others are more persuasive.

runners.comment: Lightly raced; 66-1 win at Southwell in January but she flopped back there last time
runners.name: Pride Eye
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who caused a 66-1 surprise when landing a Southwell handicap (1m) in January; only 2lb higher here but she flopped at Southwell last time and has something to prove again after that 16l defeat.

runners.comment: Won at Windsor in July 2024 but she's struggled since and has lots to prove
runners.name: Always Fearless
runners.spotlight: Won off 9lb higher at Windsor (1m) in July 2024 but she's struggled since, including in two runs last summer; has lots to prove after another absence and she needs a major revival.

runners.comment: Overall record of 2-35 and he's finished down the field at Lingfield in last two starts
runners.name: Raqraaq
runners.spotlight: Both wins have come on Polytrack at Lingfield but latest was 14 months ago; on dangerous mark and was placed at Lingfield (1m) in November but he's taken two backward steps since and overall record is now 2-35.

runners.comment: Eyecatching third here in October and she looks interesting at this new trip for new yard
runners.name: Eulalia
runners.spotlight: 4yo who had five runs for Charlie Fellowes last year and she found improvement when a strong-finishing third in a handicap here (7f) in October; on same mark on return for new yard and she's an interesting contender on this step up to 1m; tongue-tie added.

runners.comment: No impact in his last two runs and his tactical speed will be tested back at this trip
runners.name: Dubai Harbour
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been over 1m2f on Polytrack at Lingfield; several respectable efforts there since October but he's been well held in last two runs and his tactical speed will be tested back at this trip.

17:40.race_name: Sporting Times Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div II)

runners.comment: Nine-race maiden who has not progressed and has finished down the field in three handicaps
runners.name: Dodging The Bullet
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden including three runs over hurdles; showed some early promise on the Flat but he's not progressed and has finished down the field in three handicaps at Lingfield (1m2f/1m) this year; down the list.

runners.comment: 0-7 for three different stables and he needs to raise his game back at 1m; headgear added
runners.name: Hawaiian King
runners.owner: Aura Racing Dave Brown Joe Lane
runners.spotlight: 0-7 for three different stables; ran well when third in a Wolverhampton handicap (9.4f) in December but he's not gone on from that and has been well held in both runs (1m2f/1m4f) for current yard; cheekpieces are now added and he needs to raise his game back at this trip.

runners.comment: Hard to predict and was tailed off recent stable debut at Wolverhampton; passed over
runners.name: Charming Fellow
runners.spotlight: In and out for Peter Chapple-Hyam and he ran poorly on final start for that yard in October; changed hands for 3,500gns after that and he was tailed off on recent stable debut at Wolverhampton (9.4f); record is now 1-12 and he has plenty to prove; cheekpieces worn last twice are removed.

runners.comment: Dual course winner who went close at Southwell in January; respected back on Polytrack
runners.name: The Spotlight Kid
runners.spotlight: Dual course winner who went close at Southwell (1m) in January and has finished a respectable fourth there in last two runs; this step back up in trip looks a positive and he's respected back on Polytrack; reapplied blinkers replace a visor.

runners.comment: Has been out of sorts since last July and he needs a major revival for new yard
runners.name: Manton Road
runners.spotlight: Four-time AW winner who is on a dangerous mark but he's been out sorts since last July; now returns to AW but he's been off for four months and needs a major revival for new yard.

runners.comment: Won at Lingfied before a good third in a Newcastle handicap 11 days ago; respected
runners.name: Rosemarys Rose
runners.spotlight: Record of 1-12 but her win was at Lingfield (1m classified) last month and she backed that up with good third in a handicap at Newcastle; on same mark here and she should go well again back on Polytrack.

runners.comment: Nine-race maiden who has been beaten 9l or more in his last four handicaps; opposable
runners.name: Cezarro
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 4yo; nine-race maiden and he's been beaten 9l or more in his last four handicaps including on stable debut at Southwell (1m) in January; opposable.

runners.comment: Won at Lingfield (1m) in January and he had excuse there last time; could bounce back
runners.name: Celtic John
runners.spotlight: 13th time lucky when landing a classified event at Lingfield (1m) last month; flopped back in a handicap there (1m2f) last time but he had an overreach on his right fore and he could bounce back on this drop back in trip.

runners.comment: Well held over C&D in last two runs and losing run is now up to 22
runners.name: Marchetti
runners.spotlight: Has lots of Kempton form but she's been well held over C&D in last two runs; still has a poor strike-rate and losing run is up to 22.

14:15.race_name: Join Southwell Golf Club Handicap Chase

runners.comment: Lacks consistency but scored over C&D in December and has possibilities on that form
runners.name: Flash In The Park
runners.owner: Mt Hughes John Lawson Stephanie Kaye
runners.spotlight: Lacks consistency but registered a success in a deeper C&D event (good to soft; off just 2lb lower) in December and has possibilities provided he's back in similar form.

runners.comment: In-form contender who may still have further progress in her at an ordinary level
runners.name: Sea Thrift
runners.spotlight: Faller on chase debut but made all at Plumpton (2m1f, soft) next time then ran creditably at Sedgefield; may still have further progress in her at an ordinary level; respected.

runners.comment: Record for current yard leaves a lot to be desired; second attempt over fences
runners.name: Model Approach
runners.spotlight: Well treated on best hurdles form but his record for current yard leaves a lot to be desired; switch to fences made no difference last time; the weakest contender.

14:45.race_name: Grace And Dotty Fedora's And Feathers Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Record of 51211 in Class 4 handicap hurdles; interesting back at this level on chase debut
runners.name: Solar System
runners.spotlight: Record of 51211 in Class 4 handicap hurdles; has failed to fire in a couple of Class 3 events this term but looks interesting back down in grade on chase debut.

runners.comment: Fitting of blinkers may prompt a resurgence; well treated on best chase efforts
runners.name: Storminhome
runners.spotlight: Well treated on best chase efforts; has suffered a couple of heavy defeats since returning from sizeable layoff but the fitting of blinkers may prompt a resurgence.

runners.comment: Solid record off current mark includes a second-place finish in this race last year
runners.name: Lilting Verse
runners.spotlight: Solid record off current mark comprises a success at Huntingdon in 2024 and second-place finishes in this race last year and at Ffos Las in October; not ruled out.

runners.comment: Disappointing when bidding to take his Market Rasen record to 3-3; 0-6 at Southwell
runners.name: Kayce Dutton
runners.spotlight: Disappointing last time when bidding to take his record at Market Rasen and in cheekpieces to 3-3; he's 0-6 at Southwell and doesn't look the percentage call.

runners.comment: Has possibilities off current mark provided he revives; third start for new yard
runners.name: Jasmin De Cotte
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 7yo who has a doubt over current form but has possibilities off current mark provided he revives; third start for Dan Skelton, who also runs Storminhome.

runners.comment: Proving consistent and she is 1-1 at Southwell (scored comfortably); respected
runners.name: Smurfette
runners.spotlight: Latest effort, upped to this grade, suggests she remains in form; proving consistent and she is 1-1 at Southwell (scored comfortably in November 2024); respected.

15:15.race_name: Watch Unbridled On attheraces.com Open Hunters' Chase

runners.comment: Hunter chase debutant who faces a difficult task on rules form
runners.name: Camino Rocio
runners.spotlight: Has proved consistent in points this winter and looks likely to give his running in this hunter chase debut; however, faces a difficult task on rules form, as ratings reflect.

runners.comment: Yet to win beyond 2m4f and faces a stiff task at the weights
runners.name: Hold Onto The Line
runners.spotlight: Has folded in a couple of points for new yard and his record over 3m remains far from solid; yet to win beyond 2m4f and faces a stiff task at the weights; hunter chase debut.

runners.comment: Scored at Ludlow last time on hunter chase debut; this is a weaker race; respected
runners.name: Java Point
runners.spotlight: Successful at Ludlow (3m, good to soft) last time on hunter chase debut and second start for new stable, showing he retains plenty of vitality aged 11; this is a weaker race; respected.

runners.name: Twoforthegutter
runners.spotlight: In good form on turf when last seen last summer, notably when winning at Hamilton (1m4f, good) two starts ago; also suited by this C&D but resumes on a fairly tough mark.

runners.comment: Didn't run badly over 9.4f here last time but needs improvement on first try beyond 1m3f
runners.name: El Ghaawy
runners.owner: Jwi Building Solutions J Kelly & Partner
runners.spotlight: Unplaced all six starts; didn't run badly when sixth of nine here (9.4f) in January, but needs improvement on this first venture beyond 1m3f.

runners.comment: Placed in four classified races here this year; ought to be competitive again today
runners.name: Desiderata
runners.spotlight: Placed in four consecutive classified races over 9.4f/1m4f here this year, the last twice under Zoe Lewis; might be slightly better suited by the shorter trip, but ought to be very competitive again on this handicap return.

runners.comment: Sound effort when fourth over C&D in December but safely held since; others appeal more
runners.name: Virtual Hug
runners.owner: Mike Harris Racing & Nikki Evans Racing
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D winner, latterly in spring 2024; returned to the Flat with very respectable C&D handicap fourth in December, but was below that form in a classified race here in January; others appeal more.

runners.comment: Out of form over hurdles this season and only fourth in C&D classified on Flat return
runners.name: Bigz Belief
runners.spotlight: This season's hurdling form for Fergal O'Brien was uninspiring and he was safely held when fourth in C&D classified race on Flat return in January; difficult to enthuse over.

runners.comment: Not firing on all cylinders since returning from break in October; revival needed
runners.name: Busby
runners.spotlight: Veteran who gained the last six of his 12 wins on Tapeta; has not been firing on all cylinders since returning from break in October; revival needed.
